name: Hikage Narumi
source:
The fiery vice-chief of the guardians. She’s mostly nice, friendly and cheerful, however she seems to act way too competitively and attempts to be very serious when she is with Chief Miyu. She easily warms up to everyone, but seems to never be on friendly terms with Miyu. Likes to train with the MC for his judo, but he gets beaten up most of the time.

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=120]MangaGamer[/url]]
